scope: Dataset curation and reproducible counterexamples only. No analyzer changes, baseline/model predictions, RL training or publication.
selection: Start with public issues543/544/545 and linked upstream repair PRs; add4 source-selected scalar reward controls with explicit task meaning and standard-library-only scoring dependencies. Retain unsupported/ambiguous subjects separately.
artifact_unit: Version-pinned real scoring method + task contract + dependency source + counterexamples + issue/fix provenance. Version pairs and multiple probes are correlated, not independent bugs.
fix_labels: Merged fixes, proposed upstream fixes and locally authored repairs must remain distinct. No local repair is presented as upstream.
normal_labels: Scoped to declared task/input contract and evidence; no global absence-of-bugs claim.
execution_policy: Do not import or execute upstream modules/generators/framework/training. Execute only AST-checked extracted real scoring methods and necessary pure helpers with allowlisted stdlib dependencies in a time-bounded offline subprocess. No new dependency installation. Record exact harness adaptations and AST correspondence.
test_inputs: Small explicit contract/witness inputs, not sampled hidden benchmark rows. Additional boundary and legitimate partial-credit probes separately marked.
future_evaluation: All source bodies inspected now are development/exposed material. No unseen-helper or generalization claim; freeze data and record source exposure before analyzer work.
preserve: Do not alter v10 code, results, report or existing archives.
